items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: I remember Ernst Tubb. We liked very much personally, the Walking the Floor over you.

ctx.x: Well, how did you regard yourself via people like Roy Acuff and the Grand Ole Opry crew?

Oh, we liked them personally. Roy Acuff for a while was there in Fort Worth when he wrote Walking the Floor. Is that the Walking the Floor over you guys? Or Ernst Tubb. Ernst Tubb. I remember Ernst Tubb. We liked very much personally, the Walking the Floor over you. We kind of looked over there. We smiled. We thought that was kind of vaudeville or something really, you know, and we liked him okay, but he's kind of just a personality singer. The same way now, I'd be tolerant. Elvis Presley, you know, he's alright.…
And you regarded the Nashville group of people as another kind of music?
